# EnterpriseGlue v0.28.6 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.28.5`.

## Highlights

- **backend-bootstrap:** Runs an explicitly authorized configuration-bundle bootstrap when database schema startup remains in verify-only mode.

## User and administrator impact

- Cloud deployments can apply approved platform identity providers without granting application replicas schema-migration or generic seed authority.

## Configuration

- Configuration-bundle validate/apply mode remains independently controlled by EG_CONFIG_BOOTSTRAP_MODE; EG_DATABASE_STARTUP_MODE=verify still blocks migrations and generic seed writers.

## Database migrations

- The fix changes startup orchestration only and adds no schema migration.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Configuration application retains its existing hash, tenant-scope, secret-preflight and fail-closed checks while schema and seed writers remain disabled in verify mode.

## Documentation

- The generated technical release notes describe the independent database-startup and configuration-bootstrap authorities.

## Rollback

- Redeploy the previous backend image; no database or configuration rollback is required.

## Validation evidence

- Startup-boundary tests cover successful and fail-closed configuration bootstrap in verify mode while proving migrations and generic seed writers remain disabled.
- The configuration-bootstrap suite, backend-host build, focused lint and release-note preflight pass.
